newsitem.title: USA: Fed expected to add reserves through system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed expected to add reserves through system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to inject reserves into the banking system Monday morning during its new 1030EST/1530GMT intervention time.
Analysts said they expected either seven- or 10-day system repurchase agreements.

Economists at UBS Securities estimated the Fed began the current two-week maintenance period facing an underlying daily add need of about $9 billion and that the outstanding 13- and seven-day system RPs total $4.5 billion.

"Unveiling its new policy of announcing the size of its system repo operations, the Fed reported that the size of Thursday's overnight system repo was $7.6 billion and Friday's weekend system repo was $1.1 billion. Based on these reserve injections, we see a $7.0 billion daily add need in the remaining 10 days of the (two-week maintenance) period," UBS economists wrote.
Federal funds were trading at the 5-1/4 percent Fed target.
((-- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1663))
